title: Full reps or half reps? 📏
caption:
Full range of motion builds as much muscle as partials, or more. Newer studies show the stretched part matters most: half reps at the bottom can work about as well, half reps at the top grow the least. Full reps or ego reps? 👇

Muscle Building, Part 16
